functionDeclarations.name: omarchy_control
functionDeclarations.description: Sub-millisecond native Omarchy OS & Hyprland desktop controller. Controls window management (close, fullscreen, float, cycle), workspace switching (1-10), desktop themes & dynamic wallpaper switching, hardware toggles (nightlight, status bar, touchpad, stay-awake), service restarts (audio, bluetooth, wifi, shell), screen capture/OCR, and OSD notifications.

target.description: Optional argument or target: workspace number ('1'-'10'), theme name ('Nord', 'Tokyo Night'), direction ('l', 'r', 'u', 'd'), or notification text.

functionDeclarations.name: launch_application
functionDeclarations.description: Launches a desktop GUI application or opens a website in the default browser. Resolves smart aliases ('terminal', 'calc', 'editor', 'browser') and web shortcuts ('youtube', 'github', 'gmail', 'chatgpt', 'claude').

app_name.description: Name of the application (e.g. 'code', 'google-chrome', 'nautilus', 'kitty') or URL/shortcut (e.g. 'youtube', 'https://github.com').

args.description: Optional command-line arguments to pass to the application binary.

functionDeclarations.name: close_window
functionDeclarations.description: Closes the active window, a specific named application window, or browser tabs.

target.description: Window title, application name, or 'active' for the focused window. Supports 'tab' to close current browser tab.

functionDeclarations.name: close_tab
functionDeclarations.description: Closes the currently active browser tab via native keyboard shortcut synthesis (Ctrl+W).

functionDeclarations.name: close_all_tabs
functionDeclarations.description: Closes all active web browser windows and tabs.

functionDeclarations.name: set_system_volume
functionDeclarations.description: Sets or adjusts master audio sink volume, or toggles mute status.

volume.description: Absolute target volume percentage from 0 to 150.

mute.description: Set to true to mute audio, false to unmute.

toggleMute.description: Set to true to toggle mute state.

functionDeclarations.name: get_system_volume
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieves the current system master volume percentage and mute status.

functionDeclarations.name: set_display_brightness
functionDeclarations.description: Adjusts display monitor backlight brightness level.

functionDeclarations.name: get_screen_brightness
functionDeclarations.description: Reads current display monitor backlight brightness percentage.

functionDeclarations.name: set_power_profile
functionDeclarations.description: Switches the system power management profile.

functionDeclarations.name: control_media_playback
functionDeclarations.description: Controls active desktop media playback (Spotify, Chrome, Firefox, VLC) via MPRIS2.

functionDeclarations.name: system_power_action
functionDeclarations.description: Executes system power and session state transitions.

functionDeclarations.name: take_screenshot
functionDeclarations.description: Captures a full-resolution screenshot of the desktop screen.

outputPath.description: Optional file path where the screenshot PNG will be saved.

functionDeclarations.name: desktop_control
functionDeclarations.description: Deterministic computer use input automation (mouse clicks, movement, typing text, hotkeys).

x.description: X coordinate for mouse click or move.

y.description: Y coordinate for mouse click or move.

functionDeclarations.name: clipboard_control
functionDeclarations.description: Reads or writes text to the system clipboard across Wayland and X11.

text.description: Text content to copy to clipboard (required if action is 'write').

functionDeclarations.name: manage_systemd_service
functionDeclarations.description: Controls and inspects systemd system and user service units.

functionDeclarations.name: manage_process
functionDeclarations.description: Terminates or signals running processes by process name or PID.

processName.description: Name of the process to signal or terminate.

pid.description: Specific Process ID to signal or terminate.

signal.description: Signal to send (e.g. 'SIGTERM', 'SIGKILL'). Defaults to SIGTERM.

functionDeclarations.name: control_vision_mode
functionDeclarations.description: Enables or disables real-time camera feed or screen sharing feed to the AI voice session.

functionDeclarations.name: execute_linux_command
functionDeclarations.description: Executes an arbitrary Linux shell command asynchronously with timeout protection.

command.description: The bash shell command line to execute.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before terminating (default 10.0s).

functionDeclarations.name: get_system_telemetry
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieves real-time CPU usage, RAM utilization, disk free space, uptime, and load averages.

functionDeclarations.name: run_full_system_diagnostics
functionDeclarations.description: Performs a full preflight diagnostic sweep across hardware sensors, memory integrity, and audio actuators.
